title: The Unusual noise in the night
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：unusual　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 unusual 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the planner wrote of ① an unusual noise in the night in the report, and everybody in the district said at once that it was ② so unusual that nobody in the district would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the planner, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the unusual ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the unusual noise in the night that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report for March 1949 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too unusual to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the citizen who had come to help; the unusual ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an unusual gift for languages, and said that no citizen in his right mind would call it ⑥ as unusual as the gift for languages they had once had in the old district. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was unusual or not, and he said so.

By 1962 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was ⑦ something unusual, and nothing besides. The citizen from the next district called the whole plan ⑧ quite unusual; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the report kept the names of the unusual ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1965, with great care, she wrote of another unusual noise in the night in the same report, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less unusual than anybody had expected. ⑩ The unusual gift for languages that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1967, was the one she could never quite name; the unusual ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 不寻常（前置定语 an unusual noise in the night：1955 年规划员在规划报告里记下的那件不寻常的声响）
B. adj. 不寻常／罕见（两处加强说法：so unusual that … 与 no less unusual than …）
C. adj. 不寻常／罕见（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 不寻常（表语 too unusual to do：母亲觉得它太不寻常，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 罕见（前置定语 an unusual gift for languages：叔叔把整件事称作一桩罕见的语言天赋）
F. adj. 罕见（同级比较 as unusual as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩罕见的语言天赋相比）
G. adj. 罕见（后置定语 something unusual：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 罕见（受程度副词修饰 quite unusual：那位市民的评价）

items.q: an unusual noise in the night
the unusual noise in the night that
The unusual gift for languages that

answers.why: unusual 意为“不寻常”，1955 年规划员在规划报告里记下的是“一件不寻常的声响”，此处作前置定语 an unusual noise in the night。
unusual 意为“不寻常”，此处用 so unusual that 结构，说它不寻常到街区里没人敢靠近。
unusual 意为“不寻常”，规划报告上 三月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的不寻常夜里异常的声响，等于最高级的说法。
unusual 意为“不寻常”，母亲认为这件东西“太不寻常了，谁也用不上”，too unusual to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
unusual 意为“罕见”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩罕见的语言天赋”，此处作前置定语 an unusual gift for languages。
unusual 意为“罕见”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩罕见的语言天赋一样罕见”，同级比较用 as unusual as。
unusual 意为“罕见”，规划报告上那半行字要的是“罕见的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something unusual。
unusual 意为“罕见”，邻街区来的那位市民认为这套计划“相当罕见”，quite 修饰原级 unusual。
unusual 意为“罕见”，no less unusual than 表示“其罕见不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之罕见不亚于任何人的预料。
unusual 意为“罕见”，母亲 1967 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的罕见语言天赋”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年，规划员在规划报告里记下了一件不寻常的声响。（an unusual noise in the night）
它不寻常到街区里没有一个人敢靠近。（so unusual that …）
母亲觉得它太不寻常，谁也用不上。（too unusual to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩罕见的语言天赋。（an unusual gift for languages）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩罕见的语言天赋一样罕见。（as unusual as …）
到了 1962 年，规划报告上只剩半行字：要的是一件罕见的东西。（something unusual）
answers: In 1955 the planner wrote of an unusual noise in the night in the report.
It was so unusual that nobody in the district would go near it.
My mother thought it too unusual to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an unusual gift for languages.
He said nobody would call it as unusual as the gift for languages they had once had.
By 1962 the report asked for nothing but something unusual.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 unusual 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the planner wrote of an unusual noise in the night in the report, and nobody forgot it.
It was the unusual noise in the night that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report says.
My mother thought it too unusual to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an unusual gift for languages, and nobody argued with him.
The citizen from the next district called the plan quite unusual, and everybody laughed.
The unusual ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
